name: DANSS
full_name: Detector of the reactor AntiNeutrino based on Solid Scintillator
summary: DANSS measures electron antineutrinos below a commercial reactor at Kalinin. Its movable, highly segmented solid-scintillator detector compares energy spectra at different baselines to search for sterile-neutrino oscillations with limited dependence on the predicted reactor flux.
detection_principle: Inverse beta decay produces a prompt positron pattern and a delayed neutron capture on gadolinium-containing strip coatings. Scintillator strips are read out by wavelength-shifting fibres; a lifting platform changes the core-to-detector distance repeatedly.
